devdoc.author: NFTfi
devdoc.details: This contract is an implementation of the IRefinancingAdapter for the Gondi platform. It handles operations related to refinancing Gondi loans such as transferring the borrower role, paying off loans, and retrieving loan and collateral details.

getBorrowerAddress(address,uint256,bytes.details: Gets the address of the borrower for a specific Gondi loan.

params._extraData: The ABI-encoded LoanRepaymentData struct containing loan details from Gondi This data must be retrieved from events as Gondi does not provide a direct query method.

returns._0: address of the borrower from the encoded Lien struct.

getCollateral(address,uint256,bytes).details: Gets the NFT collateral information for a specific Gondi loan.

params._extraData: The ABI-encoded LoanRepaymentData struct containing loan details from Gondi

returns._0: nftCollateralContract The address of the NFT collection contract.
returns._1: nftCollateralId The token ID of the NFT used as collateral.

getPayoffDetails(address,uint256,bytes).details: Gets the payoff details for a specific Gondi loan.

params._extraData: The ABI-encoded LoanRepaymentData struct containing loan details from Gondi

returns._0: loanERC20Denomination The address of the payoff token (always WETH for Gondi).
returns._1: maximumRepaymentAmount The total amount required to pay off the loan, calculated based on the principal, interest rate, and time elapsed since loan creation.

payOffRefinancable(address,uint256,addre.details: Pays off a Gondi loan as part of the refinancing process.

params._extraData: The ABI-encoded LoanRepaymentData struct containing loan details from Gondi
params._loanContract: The address of the Gondi contract.
params._payBackAmount: The amount of WETH tokens used to pay back the Gondi loan.

returns._0: A boolean value indicating whether the operation was successful.

transferBorrowerRole(address,uint256,byt.details: Handles the borrower role transfer for Gondi loans.

returns._0: Always returns true as no additional action is required.

devdoc.title: GondiRefinancingAdapter

getPayoffDetails(address,uint256,bytes).notice: This function calculates the current debt including accrued interest at the moment of calling. We are using the exact logic from Gondi's computeCurrentDebt function

payOffRefinancable(address,uint256,addre.notice: This function calls Gondi's repay function with the loan repayment details.

transferBorrowerRole(address,uint256,byt.notice: For Gondi, no borrower role transfer is possible, unused function
